title: Find the XOR of Numbers Which Appear Twice
summary: Given an array where each number appears once or twice, return the bitwise XOR of all numbers that appear twice, or 0 if no such number exists.
statement: Given an array where each number appears once or twice, return the bitwise XOR of all numbers that appear twice, or 0 if no such number exists.
constraints: Every value appears either once or twice.
Take the bitwise XOR of the values that appear exactly twice.
Return zero when no value is duplicated.
hints: A set distinguishes first from second occurrence under the at-most-twice promise.
Store unseen values without changing the answer.
On the second occurrence, XOR that value into the answer.
Each exactly-twice value contributes once and every singleton contributes zero times.
editorial: Each exactly-twice value contributes once and every singleton contributes zero times.

tests.explanation: Only one appears twice, so the XOR is one.
No value appears twice, so return zero.
